itemDisplayName: AI Gateway tier (preview) TC01: Bicep + script
description: TC01 happy path for the Azure API Management AI Gateway tier (preview). Bicep creates a Microsoft Foundry account, project, and gpt-5.4 model deployment (East US 2, local auth DISABLED). You then create the gateway and import the model from https://ai.gateway.azure.com choosing Managed identity backend auth: the gateway's system-assigned identity (no user-assigned identity required) is granted the Foundry User role on the account, so no Foundry key is stored. Add a token rate-limit policy, then test the model through the gateway with the included Python script. Verified against https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/api-management/ai-gateway-manage-models-tools.
summary: Keyless variant of the AI Gateway tier TC01. Bicep = Foundry account + project + gpt-5.4 model with local auth disabled. Portal = create gateway + Import from Foundry (Managed identity, system-assigned, Foundry User role) + token rate-limit policy. Script = OpenAI-compatible chat completion through the gateway. No UAMI, no stored Foundry key.
